errors.text_span: Deutschland und Dänemark mit jeweils etwa 71 %
errors.evidence: The bar for Deutschland is at approximately 71%, but the bar for Dänemark is visibly lower, at approximately 70%. Attributing the same value to both is incorrect.

errors.text_span: Die Werte für das Vereinigte Königreich, Südkorea und die USA liegen jeweils bei etwa 60 %.
errors.evidence: This groups three bars with distinct values (approx. 61%, 60%, and 59%) into a single approximation of 60%, losing precision.

errors.text_span: Die Balken sind nicht nach Höhe sortiert
errors.evidence: The bars are clearly sorted in descending order of their value (height) from left to right. The statement that they are not sorted is factually incorrect.
